description: A target repository keeps exactly three append-only ledgers (intents, plans, executions) plus their per-flow fragments. Nothing checks that no fourth ledger-like store appears, nor that rows already on the base branch stay byte-identical on a pull request head.
goal: Add two standalone checks and run them in a new CI workflow on pull requests. (1) A store check lists the ledger stores in the repository (the three ledger files, the per-flow fragment directories for those three, and any other jsonl file outside the knowledge base failure and wisdom folders) and fails when the set is not exactly those three kinds. (2) A diff check compares every ledger file and fragment on the base branch with the head and fails when a base row changed, moved or disappeared; added rows and new fragments pass, and an unreadable base fails closed. Each check is a small script with importable functions. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: The ledgers are the audit trail; a fourth store or an edited row breaks the audit invariant silently, and only a machine check keeps it from slipping through.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/check_ledger_stores.py passes on the current repository layout and fails on a reconstructed violation; test_ledger_stores_exactly_three.py builds a temporary repository with a fourth jsonl ledger-like file and proves the failure, and proves the clean layout passes.

scripts/check_ledger_rows_append_only.py fails when a base row is edited, deleted or reordered and passes when rows are only added or a new fragment appears; test_ledger_rows_append_only_diff.py proves each case on a hermetic git repository, and an unreadable base fails closed.
.github/workflows/test-ledger-invariants.yml runs both scripts on pull requests; the workflow file is new and no existing workflow file is edited.

No docstrings and no comments except '# why:' in anything added; every new module is at most 200 lines; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged; 'uv run pytest' on the new tests, 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
